reviewer: Separate Claude review agent, independent of the collector and extractor; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the therapeutic target validation batch for use-case-therapeutic-target-validation: 770 records (439 results, 223 evaluations, 47 configurations, 20 methods, 16 models, 10 datasets, 9 claims including 3 relevance judgements, 3 protocols, 3 sources). The three source PDFs re-download to their pinned SHA-256; by decision they are not archived in the batch. All 439 results were re-read from the PDF text layers with a separate parser and match in value, printed form, metric, unit, direction, locator, configuration, protocol and dataset. Descriptive corrections, none of which changes a value, are listed in docs/reviews/use-cases/therapeutic-target-validation-2026-10-09.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review and not reproduction of any method or screen.
The source PDFs are pinned by hash but not archived in the batch, so later review needs a fresh download.
Roohani Appendix Table 7 (standard deviations), figures, Gupta Table 3 and AssayBench appendix tables other than Table 3 were not checked.

Biomni authorship overlap with AssayBench, which Schmidt et al. 2022 screen the benchmarks replay, and whether AssayBench Precision@100 and dFDR@100 were condensed could not be established from the sources.
Relevance judgements are reviewed but not pinned; the lead records pins with npm run use-cases:repin after the use-case change, including the two CPPC judgements.
The SHACL step of records add and npm run build were not run; a dry-run addBatch against a scratch copy of the store accepted all 770 records.

record_ids: 48 tgtval-20261009-eval-roohani2025-* evaluations for the GeneDisco acquisition functions and DiscoBAX
findings.message: origin author_reported changed to independent_paper; those methods were developed by Mehrjou et al. 2021 and Lyle et al. 2023.
uncertainty reason unreported changed to unextracted; Appendix Table 7 prints one standard deviation.
Denominator min(100, positive-relevance genes) added to metric_qualifier so the values are not compared with fixed-denominator precision at 100.
Limitation said the replication was lower on four of five screens; it is lower on three of the four with a reported value.
Unassayed genes are removed only for AnDCG@100; the printed Precision@100 and dFDR@100 formulas do not state that step. Post-cutoff limitation corrected: two systems score higher on that cohort.
Names asserted CRISPRa; the source reports activation and interference screens and the benchmark describes knockdown.
Split from one comparison group with three headline metrics into one group each.
